sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的新作，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 本期节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，可能不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Four-year-old Kevin Yalmussen loved his bicycle more than anything.
sentences.zh: 四岁的凯文·亚尔穆森最心爱的东西就是他的自行车。

sentences.en: The little boy was a familiar face around Dottavik, the small Swedish suburb he lived in with his mother, Therese, and half-sister, Isabella.
sentences.zh: 这个小男孩是多塔维克社区里的熟面孔，他与母亲特蕾丝和同母异父的姐姐伊莎贝拉住在这个瑞典小郊区。

sentences.en: He was often seen riding happily around the neighbourhood, waving to those he knew as he cycled by.
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到他骑着车在社区里快乐地穿梭，骑过时还会向认识的人挥手致意。

sentences.en: The residential area was located on the shores of the Shirkvikan Bay, just three kilometres outside central Arvika.
sentences.zh: 这个住宅区位于希尔克维肯湾岸边，距离阿尔维卡市中心仅三公里。

sentences.en: It was a close-knit community, and residents mostly trusted one another.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关系紧密的社区，居民们大多互相信任。

sentences.en: Therefore, it was common practice for the local children to play around town without supervision, provided they steer clear of the main roads and lake.
sentences.zh: 因此，当地的孩子们在无人看管的情况下在镇上玩耍是很常见的，只要他们避开主干道和湖泊即可。

sentences.en: They never veered too far, and a familiar adult was never too far away.
sentences.zh: 他们从不走得太远，而且附近总有熟悉的成年人。

sentences.en: Sunday, August 16, 1998 was the last day of holidays before school returned for the year, and the sun made a much welcome appearance.
sentences.zh: 1998年8月16日，星期日，是新学年开学前的最后一天假期，阳光明媚，令人倍感舒适。

sentences.en: It was the perfect opportunity for Kevin Yalmussen to play outside on his bike.
sentences.zh: 这对凯文·亚尔穆森来说，是骑车外出玩耍的绝佳机会。

sentences.en: After breakfast, he rode over to meet his friend, Robin, and the two played all morning before Kevin went to his grandparents' house for lunch.
sentences.zh: 早餐后，他骑车去找朋友罗宾，两人玩了一上午，随后凯文去了祖父母家吃午饭。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he ducked home, where his mother, Therese, was busy preparing for Isabella's return to school the following day.
sentences.zh: 之后，他跑回家，当时他的母亲特蕾丝正忙着为伊莎贝拉第二天返校做准备。

sentences.en: She agreed to let Kevin go out again, as long as he didn't stay out too late.
sentences.zh: 她同意让凯文再出去玩一会儿，只要别太晚回来就行。

sentences.en: By 6.30pm, Kevin hadn't returned home, and Therese was starting to worry.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚6点30分，凯文还没回家，特蕾丝开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Hoping he'd just lost track of time and was busy playing somewhere, she enlisted Kevin's grandparents to help her look around town.
sentences.zh: 她心想他可能只是玩忘了时间，于是叫上凯文的祖父母帮她在镇上四处寻找。

sentences.en: They searched Kevin's usual haunts, including the playgrounds, local school, and football field, but there was no sign of him anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他们搜寻了凯文常去的地方，包括游乐场、当地学校和足球场，但哪里都没有他的踪影。

sentences.en: The football field backed on to Shirkviken Bay, a large lake dotted with trees and walking paths.
sentences.zh: 足球场背靠希尔克维肯湾，那是一个树木环绕、步道纵横的大湖。

sentences.en: They followed the path towards the lake, where his grandmother noticed something propped up against a grassy mound behind a small wooden shed.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着小路走向湖边，祖母注意到一个小木棚后的草堆旁立着什么东西。

sentences.en: It was Kevin's bicycle, his prized possession, which he took with him everywhere.
sentences.zh: 那是凯文的自行车，他最珍贵的宝贝，去哪儿都带着它。

sentences.en: Dred washed over Kevin's family.
sentences.zh: 恐惧瞬间笼罩了凯文的家人。

sentences.en: They called Kevin's name, but there was no response.
sentences.zh: 他们呼喊着凯文的名字，却没有任何回应。

sentences.en: Something must be horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 一定出大事了。

sentences.en: There was no way Kevin would stray too far from his beloved bike.
sentences.zh: 凯文绝不可能离开他心爱的自行车走得太远。

sentences.en: Like the other children in the neighbourhood, Kevin was strictly forbidden from playing near the lake, a rule he happily obeyed as he couldn't swim and was afraid of the water.
sentences.zh: 和社区里的其他孩子一样，凯文被严禁在湖边玩耍，他很乐意遵守这条规定，因为他不会游泳，而且怕水。

sentences.en: However, a sailboat was bobbing in the water, and his family wondered if Kevin might have been interested enough to get a closer look.
sentences.zh: 然而，水面上漂着一艘帆船，家人们不禁怀疑凯文是否因为好奇而想凑近看看。

sentences.en: They trepidatiously headed towards the lake, calling Kevin's name repeatedly as they walked.
sentences.zh: 他们战战兢兢地朝湖边走去，一边走一边不停地呼喊凯文的名字。

sentences.en: At the shore, Kevin's grandfather glanced over towards an area of reeds and slumped over in shock.
sentences.zh: 在岸边，凯文的祖父朝一片芦苇丛望去，随即震惊地瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: There, lying face down on a wooden pallet amongst the reeds, was Kevin.
sentences.zh: 凯文正脸朝下躺在芦苇丛中的一块木托盘上。

sentences.en: Kevin's grandfather carried Kevin's lifeless body to shore, and his grandmother administered mouth-to-mouth resuscitation while waiting for the paramedics.
sentences.zh: 祖父将凯文毫无生气的身体抱上岸，祖母在等待医护人员的同时对他进行了人工呼吸。

sentences.en: Kevin was rushed to hospital, but all attempts to revive him were fruitless.
sentences.zh: 凯文被紧急送往医院，但所有的抢救尝试都无济于事。

sentences.en: At 11pm, he was officially pronounced deceased, with the cause of death determined to be drowning.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点，他被正式宣告死亡，死因被确定为溺水。

sentences.en: It was standard protocol for local law enforcement to look into drowning incidents, and as soon as investigators saw Kevin's body, they knew this wasn't a typical drowning case.
sentences.zh: 当地执法部门调查溺水事件是标准程序，但调查人员一看到凯文的遗体，就知道这并非典型的溺水案件。

sentences.en: For starters, Kevin's shoes and one of his socks were missing.
sentences.zh: 首先，凯文的鞋子和一只袜子不见了。

sentences.en: There were also visible injuries to the front of his neck and abdomen.
sentences.zh: 他的颈部前方和腹部也有明显的伤痕。

sentences.en: While it was possible that these injuries were caused by his body rubbing against the wooden pallet as it moved in the water, this was unlikely.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些伤痕有可能是他在水中漂浮时身体与木托盘摩擦造成的，但这种可能性很小。

sentences.en: The pallet Kevin had been found lying on was in water approximately 20 centimetres deep.
sentences.zh: 凯文被发现时所在的木托盘位于约20厘米深的水中。

sentences.en: When his grandparents found him, only his left hand had been trailing in the water while the rest of his body was afloat on the pallet.
sentences.zh: 当祖父母发现他时，只有他的左手拖在水里，而身体的其他部分都浮在托盘上。

sentences.en: Even though Kevin couldn't swim, it didn't make sense that he could have drowned in such shallow water.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯文不会游泳，但在这么浅的水里溺亡实在说不通。

sentences.en: An official autopsy confirmed investigators' suspicions.
sentences.zh: 官方尸检证实了调查人员的怀疑。

sentences.en: The whites of Kevin's eyes showed clear signs of bleeding, which is a telltale indication of strangulation.
sentences.zh: 凯文眼球的白眼仁处有明显的出血迹象，这是勒死的典型特征。

sentences.en: There were also bruises to his genitals and signs of sexual assault, as well as sand in his underwear.
sentences.zh: 他的生殖器也有淤伤和性侵迹象，内裤里还发现了沙子。

sentences.en: This wasn't a tragic drowning accident at all, but a cold-blooded murder.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是什么悲惨的溺水事故，而是一起冷血谋杀。

sentences.en: The area where Kevin's body was found was cordoned off, although authorities kept it under wraps that they were investigating the boy's death as anything other than an accident.
sentences.zh: 发现凯文遗体的区域被封锁了，尽管当局对外隐瞒了他们正将此案作为非意外死亡进行调查的事实。

sentences.en: The local school was right next door, so parents and children arrived to a dramatic scene when they returned for the school year on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 当地学校就在隔壁，所以周一早上返校的学生和家长们目睹了这一惊人的现场。

sentences.en: As officers assessed the area, two students approached and handed over a pair of black of Velcro strapped sandals and a single purple sock.
sentences.zh: 当警察评估现场时，两名学生走过来，交出了一双黑色的魔术贴凉鞋和一只紫色的袜子。

sentences.en: They belonged to Kevin, and the children had found them behind the small shed where his bike had been abandoned.
sentences.zh: 这些都是凯文的，孩子们是在他自行车被遗弃的小棚子后面发现的。

sentences.en: The shed was approximately 30 metres from where Kevin's body was found, and the path leading up to it contained similar sand to that which was found in Kevin's underwear.
sentences.zh: 棚子距离发现凯文遗体的地方约30米，通往棚子的小路上有和凯文内裤里发现的类似的沙子。

sentences.en: This led investigators to theorise that he could have been killed near the shed before being moved to the pallet.
sentences.zh: 这让调查人员推测，他可能是在棚子附近遇害，随后才被移到托盘上的。

sentences.en: Fluorescent clothing fibres were found on the path, although none were detected on the pallet or on Kevin's body.
sentences.zh: 小路上发现了荧光色的衣物纤维，但在托盘或凯文身上却未检测到。

sentences.en: A seven centimetre long bruise on Kevin's neck indicated that he'd been killed by someone pressing a hard, sharp object against his throat.
sentences.zh: 凯文颈部一道七厘米长的淤痕表明，他是被某人用坚硬、尖锐的物体抵住喉咙杀害的。

sentences.en: Investigators were particularly interested in a stick that was found near the shed.
sentences.zh: 调查人员对棚子附近发现的一根木棍特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: It was around one centimetre thick and broken in the middle.
sentences.zh: 它大约一厘米粗，中间断开了。

sentences.en: Testing revealed a child-sized handprint in the bark as well as several hairs attached, leading to the conclusion that this was the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 检测显示树皮上有儿童大小的手印，还附着几根头发，由此得出结论，这就是凶器。

sentences.en: Given the proximity of the crime scene to the school, the rumour mill soon went into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 鉴于案发现场靠近学校，流言蜚语很快便甚嚣尘上。

sentences.en: Police had been canvassing the neighbourhood to question people about what they'd seen on Sunday afternoon, making it obvious that this was no open-and-shut accidental drowning.
sentences.zh: 警方一直在社区走访，询问人们周日下午看到的情况，这显然表明这绝非一起简单的意外溺水案。

sentences.en: On Thursday August 20, local suspicions that something more sinister was at play were confirmed
sentences.zh: 8月20日星期四，当地关于案件背后有更险恶阴谋的猜测得到了证实，

sentences.en: when a press conference was held to announce that the police were now treating Kevin's death as a sexual assault and murder.
sentences.zh: 因为警方召开新闻发布会宣布，他们现在将凯文的死亡定性为性侵和谋杀。

sentences.en: Kevin's parents were grief-stricken.
sentences.zh: 凯文的父母悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: They had separated before he was born, but his father Potrik had recently moved closer to Dottavik to focus on his relationship with his son.
sentences.zh: 他们在凯文出生前就分开了，但他的父亲波特里克最近搬到了离多塔维克更近的地方，以便专注于与儿子的关系。

sentences.en: The two had been growing closer, and to have Kevin suddenly snatched away left Potrik so overcome with sorrow that he was unable to leave the house.
sentences.zh: 两人的关系正日益亲密，凯文的突然离世让波特里克悲痛万分，以至于无法出门。

sentences.en: Kevin's mother, Therese, shied away from the media to focus on her grief and take care of her daughter, while also trying to process unfounded accusations of neglect.
sentences.zh: 凯文的母亲特蕾丝避开了媒体，专注于哀悼并照顾女儿，同时还要应对外界毫无根据的疏忽指控。

sentences.en: Though much of the community were supportive, some parents were openly questioning how Therese could have left Kevin unsupervised.
sentences.zh: 尽管社区里大多数人都给予了支持，但一些家长公开质疑特蕾丝怎么能让凯文处于无人看管的状态。

sentences.en: She was accused of partying instead of taking care of her children.
sentences.zh: 她被指责只顾着聚会，而不照顾孩子。

sentences.en: Others cruelly labelled Kevin's grandparents as drunks, and some went as far as to comment, it was no wonder that he died.
sentences.zh: 其他人则恶毒地称凯文的祖父母是酒鬼，甚至有人评论说，他死了也不足为奇。

sentences.en: This cruel gossip exacerbated Therese's already overwhelming grief.
sentences.zh: 这些恶毒的流言加剧了特蕾丝本已沉重的悲痛。

sentences.en: As most child murders are committed by someone known to the victim, protocol dictated that Kevin's family were looked into.
sentences.zh: 由于大多数儿童谋杀案都是熟人所为，程序规定必须调查凯文的家人。

sentences.en: Not only did they all have verified alibis, but police found nothing to suggest that they were anything other than loving and supportive,
sentences.zh: 他们不仅都有确凿的不在场证明，而且警方也没有发现任何迹象表明他们不是充满爱心和支持的家人，

sentences.en: and they were quickly ruled out of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此他们很快被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Police had been trying to piece together Kevin's last known movements, but this was no easy task.
sentences.zh: 警方一直在努力拼凑凯文最后的行踪，但这绝非易事。

sentences.en: Dr Vic was a relatively lower socioeconomic area, and many residents didn't trust the police, as they felt they'd been overlooked when making reports in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 维克博士区是一个社会经济地位相对较低的地区，许多居民不信任警察，因为他们觉得过去报案时被忽视了。

sentences.en: Eventually, investigators found some who were willing to talk, and a timeline was established.
sentences.zh: 最终，调查人员找到了一些愿意交谈的人，并确定了时间线。

sentences.en: After Kevin left his mother's house on Sunday afternoon, he met up with a friend named Robert.
sentences.zh: 周日下午凯文离开母亲家后，去见了朋友罗伯特。

sentences.en: Just before 4pm, the pair rode their bikes to the home of Kevin's best friend,
sentences.zh: 下午4点前不久，两人骑车去了凯文最好的朋友家，

sentences.en: Robin, and asked if he wanted to come out and play.
sentences.zh: 也就是罗宾家，问他要不要出来玩。

sentences.en: Robin wasn't allowed to, so Kevin told Robin he'd come by the next day instead.
sentences.zh: 罗宾没被允许，于是凯文告诉罗宾他明天再来找他。

sentences.en: He and Robert then ran into a 13-year-old they knew named Felix, not his real name.
sentences.zh: 随后他和罗伯特遇到了一个他们认识的13岁男孩菲利克斯（化名）。

sentences.en: The boys looked up to Felix because he owned an impressive BMX bike with Spider-Man handlebars.
sentences.zh: 男孩们很崇拜菲利克斯，因为他有一辆很酷的BMX自行车，车把上有蜘蛛侠图案。

sentences.en: When Robert left to go home,
sentences.zh: 当罗伯特回家后，

sentences.en: Kevin was still with Felix.
sentences.zh: 凯文还和菲利克斯在一起。

sentences.en: He then played in the schoolyard with a group of other local teens and children, none of whom recalled seeing any strangers or anything suspicious in the area.
sentences.zh: 之后他在操场上和一群当地青少年及孩子玩耍，他们中没有人记得在附近看到过陌生人或任何可疑情况。

sentences.en: Several local residents had heard screaming at around 6pm, but hadn't been able to figure out where the noise was coming from.
sentences.zh: 几位当地居民在下午6点左右听到了尖叫声，但无法确定声音来源。

sentences.en: One person had gotten into their car and driven around, trying to locate the source, to no avail.
sentences.zh: 有人甚至开车四处寻找声源，但一无所获。

sentences.en: The injuries to Kevin's genital area indicated the crime may have been sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 凯文生殖器部位的伤痕表明这起犯罪可能带有性动机。

sentences.en: There were three known pedophiles who resided around Dr. Vic, one of whom lived just 100 metres from Kevin's home.
sentences.zh: 维克博士区附近住着三名已知的性犯罪者，其中一人就住在离凯文家仅100米的地方。

sentences.en: According to witnesses, this individual was seen at around midday on Sunday, holding Kevin's hand and helping him cross the street.
sentences.zh: 据目击者称，周日中午左右，有人看到此人牵着凯文的手，帮他过马路。

sentences.en: However, he had a verified alibi for that evening, as did the other two known child sex offenders.
sentences.zh: 然而，他和另外两名已知的儿童性犯罪者当晚都有确凿的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Plus, there was no evidence linking any of them to the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 此外，也没有证据将他们中的任何一人与凶器联系起来。

sentences.en: Daily press conferences were held to keep the public and media up to date with the latest developments in what came to be known as the Kevin case.
sentences.zh: 警方每天召开新闻发布会，向公众和媒体通报这起被称为“凯文案”的最新进展。

sentences.en: But the details of how Kevin died were withheld.
sentences.zh: 但凯文死亡的具体细节并未公布。

sentences.en: Given the sensitive nature of the crime, lead investigator Rolf Sundberry decided that a restrained approach was best, to prevent hysteria and keep speculation to a minimum.
sentences.zh: 鉴于案件的敏感性，首席调查员罗尔夫·桑德伯里决定采取克制的态度，以防止恐慌并尽量减少猜测。

sentences.en: Police appealed for anyone with information to come forward, but all they got was a series of false leads.
sentences.zh: 警方呼吁知情者提供线索，但得到的只是一连串虚假信息。

sentences.en: One woman implicated her partner in the crime, while another claimed a hitman had been hired to kill Kevin.
sentences.zh: 一名女子指控她的伴侣犯下了罪行，另一人则声称有人雇佣了杀手来杀害凯文。

sentences.en: There was no evidence to support either of these claiMs.
sentences.zh: 没有证据支持这些说法。

sentences.en: Questions were soon raised as to whether Kevin had been sexually assaulted at all.
sentences.zh: 很快有人质疑凯文是否真的遭到过性侵。

sentences.en: The pathologist who'd initially examined Kevin's body had detected white liquid around the four-year-old's rectum
sentences.zh: 最初检查凯文遗体的病理学家在四岁男孩的直肠周围检测到了白色液体，

sentences.en: and had partly based the sexual assault diagnosis on this evidence.
sentences.zh: 并部分基于这一证据做出了性侵的诊断。

sentences.en: Upon closer inspection, he realised the liquid was actually from the thermometer that had been used to determine Kevin's approximate time of death.
sentences.zh: 经过仔细检查，他意识到液体实际上来自用于测定凯文大致死亡时间的温度计。

sentences.en: Police were under immense pressure to make an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 警方承受着巨大的破案压力。

sentences.en: Not only was Kevin's death starting to make national headlines, the community had become cloaked in fear.
sentences.zh: 凯文的死不仅登上了全国头条，整个社区也笼罩在恐惧之中。

sentences.en: Children were no longer allowed to play or walk to school unsupervised, with their parents on edge that a child killer was on the loose.
sentences.zh: 孩子们不再被允许在无人看管的情况下玩耍或步行上学，家长们担心杀童凶手就在附近。

sentences.en: Adding fuel to the fire were rumours and tip-offs that immigrants were responsible.

sentences.en: Several of the children last seen playing with Kevin were refugees, including 13-year-old Felix.
sentences.zh: 最后几个和凯文一起玩的孩子中，有几名是难民，包括13岁的菲利克斯。

sentences.en: Theories arose that one of the foreign children had murdered Kevin but were refusing to admit to it because their parents had threatened to kill them if they owned up.
sentences.zh: 有人猜测是其中一个外国孩子杀害了凯文，但因为父母威胁说如果承认就杀了他们，所以他们拒绝承认。

sentences.en: These children had fled from war-torn countries where they'd witnessed all kinds of atrocities, and some believed this could have influenced their behaviour.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子从饱受战争蹂躏的国家逃离，目睹过各种暴行，有些人认为这可能影响了他们的行为。

sentences.en: Although police were eager to dispel these rumours to quell any growing xenophobia, interviewing these children proved difficult.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方急于消除这些谣言以平息日益增长的排外情绪，但采访这些孩子却困难重重。

sentences.en: Not only were there cultural differences, but given the children's experiences with war, some of them had learned not to trust authorities.
sentences.zh: 不仅存在文化差异，而且鉴于这些孩子经历过战争，其中一些人已经学会了不信任当局。

sentences.en: It was clear to police that some of them weren't telling the truth.

sentences.en: They just couldn't tell if this was because they genuinely had something to hide or because they simply didn't want to get into trouble.

sentences.en: It soon came to light that the children who'd handed in Kevin's shoes to police only knew they were behind the shed because Felix had told them so.

sentences.en: His knowledge about the shoes, along with the fact that he was one of the last people seen with Kevin, led to rumours that Felix had something to do with Kevin's death.
sentences.zh: 他对鞋子的了解，加上他是最后见到凯文的人之一，导致了菲利克斯与凯文之死有关的传言。

sentences.en: However, Felix told police he didn't hang out with Kevin at all.

sentences.zh: 然而，在最好的情况下，询问幼童关于刑事案件的问题也是极具挑战性的。

sentences.en: Not only did the children's limited vocabulary make it difficult to have straightforward conversations, but police also had to avoid asking any leading questions.
sentences.zh: 孩子们有限的词汇量不仅使直接对话变得困难，警方还必须避免提出任何诱导性问题。

sentences.en: Complicating matters further was the fact that many of the children weren't allowed to play near the lake, so they lied and told police they weren't in the area.

sentences.en: They changed their stories constantly, sometimes implicating other children, then later taking it back.
sentences.zh: 他们不断改变说法，有时牵连其他孩子，随后又推翻之前的陈述。

sentences.en: Unsure what to think or how best to proceed, they enlisted the help of professionals who were trained in dealing with children, including those with different cultural backgrounds.

sentences.en: They brought child and family psychologists on board, as well as social workers and representatives from charity organisation Save the Children.
sentences.zh: 他们请来了儿童和家庭心理学家，以及社会工作者和慈善组织“救助儿童会”的代表。

sentences.en: It was important that she built rapport with the children so they felt safe and comfortable enough to talk.

sentences.en: Hurrison, along with some of the others on the interrogation team, spent time playing with the children and chatting with them over barbecues, fishing excursions and soccer games.

sentences.en: Toys, video games and sweet treats were brought into the station to help put the children at ease.

sentences.en: Once the children felt comfortable,

sentences.zh: 罗宾不断地问什么时候能再见到他的自行车。

sentences.en: Speaking about the case,
sentences.zh: 谈到这个案件时，

sentences.en: Rolf Sundberry later commented,
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫·桑德伯格后来评论道：

sentences.en: After all the conversations we had with children, I realised that children are fully aware of their actions.
sentences.zh: 在与孩子们进行了所有谈话后，我意识到孩子们完全清楚自己的行为。

sentences.en: In the Kevin case, the boys knew they weren't playing a game.
sentences.zh: 在凯文案中，男孩们知道他们不是在玩游戏。

sentences.en: They knew that if they did something in a certain way, it could lead to death.
sentences.zh: 他们知道如果以某种方式做某事，可能会导致死亡。

sentences.en: Robin and Christian were both subject to various tests, including MRIs and
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安都接受了各种检查，包括核磁共振和

sentences.en: EEGs, to check for any brain damage or abnormalities.
sentences.zh: 脑电图，以检查是否有脑损伤或异常。

sentences.en: Authorities were interested in figuring out why the brothers had killed Kevin and whether they presented a danger in the future.
sentences.zh: 当局有兴趣弄清楚兄弟俩为什么要杀害凯文，以及他们未来是否构成危险。

sentences.en: In April of 1999, a special program titled
sentences.zh: 1999年4月，一个名为

sentences.en: Project Staircase was developed to help Christian and Robin come to terms with what they'd done and to help integrate them back into society.
sentences.zh: “楼梯计划”的特别项目启动，旨在帮助克里斯蒂安和罗宾接受他们所做的一切，并帮助他们重新融入社会。

sentences.en: As part of Project
sentences.zh: 作为“楼梯计划”的一部分，

sentences.en: Staircase, the boys would move with Vina and Eva into an apartment within a treatment facility, while a team of assistants would live in the apartment above.
sentences.zh: 男孩们将与维纳和伊娃搬进治疗机构内的一间公寓，而一组助理将住在楼上的公寓里。

sentences.en: The assistants would monitor the family's movements from
sentences.zh: 助理们会监控这家人从

sentences.en: 9am to 8pm, taking note of everything from their daily activities to their interactions to the boys' toilet breaks.
sentences.zh: 早上9点到晚上8点的行踪，记录从日常活动到互动，再到男孩们上厕所的一切细节。

sentences.en: Robin and Christian would undergo daily therapy sessions where they'd be asked how they felt about
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安将接受每日治疗，询问他们对

sentences.en: Kevin's death.
sentences.zh: 凯文之死的感受。

sentences.en: The aim was to help them process what had happened without fear of judgment or rejection.
sentences.zh: 目的是帮助他们处理所发生的事情，而不必担心被评判或排斥。

sentences.en: They'd soon be allowed to return to school on two conditions.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就可以在两个条件下重返学校。

sentences.en: An assistant would accompany them in the classroom every day and they weren't allowed to tell any of their classmates about Kevin or their involvement in his death.
sentences.zh: 一名助理每天都会陪同他们上课，而且他们不得告诉任何同学关于凯文的事，或他们参与了凯文的死亡。

sentences.en: Five months into Project
sentences.zh: 在“楼梯计划”进行五个月后，

sentences.en: Staircase, Christian was in his daily therapy session when he suddenly made a revelation.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安在进行日常治疗时突然有了一个发现。

sentences.en: The reason he had taken so long to confess was because his father had instructed him and Robin not to tell anyone how Kevin had died.
sentences.zh: 他之所以花了这么长时间才坦白，是因为他的父亲曾指示他和罗宾不要告诉任何人凯文是怎么死的。

sentences.en: The authorities were stunned.
sentences.zh: 当局惊呆了。

sentences.en: From early on, they had suspected that Viner might have been covering something up and that he may have been the one who carried Kevin's body from the jetty to the pallet.
sentences.zh: 从很早开始，他们就怀疑维纳可能隐瞒了什么，而且他可能是那个把凯文的尸体从码头搬到托盘上的人。

sentences.en: Christian's revelation only strengthened their belief.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安的揭露加强了他们的信念。

sentences.en: Deeming Viner unfit to be a parent, Robin and Christian were taken out of the clinic contemporarily put into their mother's custody.
sentences.zh: 由于认为维纳不适合做父亲，罗宾和克里斯蒂安被带离诊所，暂时交由母亲监护。

sentences.en: Viner adamantly denied having any involvement in Kevin's death or telling the boys to lie about their involvement.
sentences.zh: 维纳坚决否认参与了凯文的死亡，也否认曾告诉男孩们撒谎掩盖他们的参与。

sentences.en: The authorities decided the brothers would be best placed in foster care and set about finding suitable placements.
sentences.zh: 当局决定将兄弟俩安置在寄养家庭中，并着手寻找合适的住处。

sentences.en: However, when prospective families found out who Robin and Christian were, they wanted nothing to do with them.
sentences.zh: 然而，当潜在的家庭发现罗宾和克里斯蒂安是谁时，他们不想与他们有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: Nobody felt safe having a child killer in their homes.
sentences.zh: 没有人觉得家里住着一个杀童犯是安全的。

sentences.en: Eventually, the decision was made.
sentences.zh: 最终，决定做出了。

sentences.en: Christian would live with his mother while Robin would remain with Eva and Viner.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安将与母亲住在一起，而罗宾将与伊娃和维纳住在一起。

sentences.en: The brothers could see one another on weekends.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩可以在周末见面。

sentences.en: In early 2000, Project
sentences.zh: 2000年初，“楼梯计划”

sentences.en: Staircase officially disbanded and the families were free to live without daily supervision for the first time in over a year.
sentences.zh: 正式解散，这些家庭一年多来第一次可以在没有日常监督的情况下生活。

sentences.en: However, they still had to abide by strict rules.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们仍然必须遵守严格的规定。

sentences.en: Under no circumstances was anyone to reveal their involvement with the Kevin case.
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下，任何人都不得透露他们与凯文案的关联。

sentences.en: If an outsider ever found out their secret, a crisis plan was put in place.
sentences.zh: 如果外人发现了他们的秘密，就会启动危机预案。

sentences.en: The boys were also forbidden from returning to Arvika until they turned 18, but at this point it didn't matter anyway.
sentences.zh: 男孩们在18岁之前也被禁止回到阿尔维卡，但此时这已经不重要了。

sentences.en: None of their friends wanted anything to do with them.
sentences.zh: 他们的朋友都不想和他们有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: Although neither brother initially had any recollection of the event, they'd believed it was possible that they'd blocked the memories out, as investigators said.
sentences.zh: 虽然兄弟俩最初对这件事都没有记忆，但他们相信调查人员所说的，他们可能封锁了这些记忆。

sentences.en: As years began to pass, the whole situation remained shrouded in mystery.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月流逝，整个情况仍然笼罩在神秘之中。

sentences.en: Christian and Robin weren't allowed to talk about it with friends, and their parents seemed eager to put it all behind them and move forward.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安和罗宾不被允许与朋友谈论此事，而他们的父母似乎急于把这一切抛在脑后，继续前进。

sentences.en: But, every now and then, when life felt normal again, an unexpected abusive message would find its way into their letterbox or email accounts to remind them of their dark paSt.
sentences.zh: 但是，每当生活感觉恢复正常时，一封意想不到的辱骂信就会出现在他们的信箱或电子邮件中，提醒他们那段黑暗的过去。

sentences.en: By the time Robin was 10, his niggling concerns had developed into full-blown doubt that he was capable of hurting his best friend.
sentences.zh: 到罗宾10岁时，他内心隐隐的担忧已经演变成对自己是否有能力伤害最好的朋友的彻底怀疑。

sentences.en: It just didn't feel possible that he could have absolutely no memory of such a significant event.
sentences.zh: 他觉得对自己完全不记得如此重大的事件是不可能的。

sentences.en: He wondered if he'd simply witnessed the crime and gotten his stories mixed up.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑自己是否只是目击了犯罪，然后把故事搞混了。

sentences.en: At the same time, he was plagued by the question, what if it was me?
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他被一个问题困扰：如果是我呢？

sentences.en: Over the next few years, Robin started doing his own research about the case, using the internet to uncover any information he could get his hands on.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，罗宾开始自己研究这个案子，利用互联网挖掘他能找到的所有信息。

sentences.en: The more he learned, the more he felt he couldn't be responsible.
sentences.zh: 他了解得越多，就越觉得不可能是他干的。

sentences.en: If he was capable of such horrific behaviour, he didn't want to live.
sentences.zh: 如果他有能力做出如此可怕的行为，他就不想活了。

sentences.en: Robin's mental health began to suffer and he considered suicide.
sentences.zh: 罗宾的心理健康开始恶化，他考虑过自杀。

sentences.en: In contrast, Christian didn't want to dwell on the paSt.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，克里斯蒂安不想沉溺于过去。

sentences.en: He tried not to think about Kevin's death, but there were some things he couldn't avoid.
sentences.zh: 他尽量不去想凯文的死，但有些事情他无法避免。

sentences.en: Ever since the police interrogations had begun, Christian's sleep had suffered hugely.
sentences.zh: 自从警方审讯开始以来，克里斯蒂安的睡眠就受到了极大的影响。

sentences.en: He became so riddled with anxiety that he tossed and turned all night and could never fully relax.
sentences.zh: 他变得焦虑不安，整晚辗转反侧，无法完全放松。

sentences.en: He was afraid of the dark and would wake up in a panic several times each night.
sentences.zh: 他害怕黑暗，每晚都会惊醒好几次。

sentences.en: According to the book The Story of the
sentences.zh: 根据《凯文案的故事》一书，

sentences.zh: 在坦白后不久的一个晚上，忧郁的克里斯蒂安把母亲叫到他居住的诊所，因为他有话要告诉她。

sentences.en: When she arrived, he said,
sentences.zh: 当她到达时，他说：

sentences.en: I know nothing about Kevin.
sentences.zh: 我对凯文一无所知。

sentences.en: I wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 我当时不在场。

sentences.en: When Anika reasoned that that hadn't been what he'd told the police, Christian responded,
sentences.zh: 当安妮卡反驳说这与他告诉警察的不一样时，克里斯蒂安回答说：

sentences.en: But I just invented everything.
sentences.zh: 但我只是编造了一切。

sentences.en: Concerned, Anika reported this to the police, but they assured her that her sons had been telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 安妮卡很担心，向警方报告了此事，但他们向她保证，她的儿子们说的是实话。

sentences.en: While the interrogation reports were confidential and they couldn't reveal exactly what was said, the police confirmed that Christian and Robin had
sentences.zh: 虽然审讯报告是保密的，他们无法透露具体说了什么，但警方证实克里斯蒂安和罗宾

sentences.en: provided descriptions of Kevin's death that only those responsible could know.
sentences.zh: 提供了只有肇事者才知道的凯文死亡细节。

sentences.en: A couple of years later, in 2001, the boy's parents asked to see the transcripts of the interrogations after one senior investigator contacted them to
sentences.zh: 几年后的2001年，在一位高级调查员联系他们并

sentences.en: raise questions about the way things were handled.
sentences.zh: 对处理方式提出质疑后，男孩们的父母要求查看审讯记录。

sentences.en: Lead investigator Rolf Sundberry refused on the grounds that the investigation was classified and the parents didn't push any further.
sentences.zh: 首席调查员罗尔夫·桑德伯格以调查属于机密为由拒绝了，父母们也没有再追究。

sentences.en: From the outset, they'd felt completely out of depth when dealing with the authorities.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，他们在与当局打交道时就感到完全力不从心。

sentences.en: They had fully trusted the process and accepted that the necessary steps had to be taken to find Kevin's killer, even if it meant a few difficult months for Robin and
sentences.zh: 他们完全信任这个程序，并接受了为了找到凯文的凶手必须采取必要步骤的事实，即使这意味着罗宾和

sentences.en: Christian.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安要经历几个艰难的月份。

sentences.en: Robin eventually fell in love with a woman named Mimi, and when he was 20 years old, the two welcomed a baby boy.
sentences.zh: 罗宾最终爱上了一位名叫咪咪的女性，20岁时，两人迎来了一个男婴。

sentences.en: However, the secret about his past continued to haunt him.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于他过去的秘密继续困扰着他。

sentences.en: Robin was under strict instructions not to tell Mimi about the Kevin case, and their relationship suffered as a result.
sentences.zh: 罗宾受到严格指示，不得告诉咪咪关于凯文案的事，他们的关系也因此受到影响。

sentences.en: By the time their son was three months old, Robin and Mimi broke up, with Robin given full custody.
sentences.zh: 在儿子三个月大时，罗宾和咪咪分手了，罗宾获得了完全监护权。

sentences.en: Christian had done his best to push the Kevin case to the back of his mind, but he found it impossible to live a normal life with such a huge secret in his paSt.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安尽最大努力把凯文案抛在脑后，但他发现带着这样一个巨大的过去秘密，根本无法过上正常的生活。

sentences.en: By the time he was in his early twenties, the thought occurred to him for the first time,
sentences.zh: 当他二十出头时，他第一次产生了一个念头：

sentences.en: what if he didn't do it?
sentences.zh: 如果不是他做的呢？

sentences.en: Christian was still in close contact with the child psychologist, Bent Joran Jornson, who he'd been seeing ever since the police interrogations.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安仍与儿童心理学家本特·约兰·约翰逊保持密切联系，自警方审讯以来他一直都在看这位医生。

sentences.en: He voiced his concerns to Jornson, but he assured him he could put his mind at ease.
sentences.zh: 他向约翰逊表达了自己的担忧，但医生向他保证，他可以放下心来。

sentences.en: There was no doubt that Christian and Robin were responsible.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，克里斯蒂安和罗宾是责任人。

sentences.en: Professor Rickard Sherberry specialised in neuroscience at Umeå University in northern
sentences.zh: 瑞克德·谢伯里教授是瑞典北部于默奥大学的神经科学专家，

sentences.en: Sweden, and he had a particular fascination with forensic psychology.
sentences.zh: 他对法医心理学有着浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: In 2010, Professor Sherberry became involved with a high-profile case that shocked Sweden to the core.
sentences.zh: 2010年，谢伯里教授参与了一起轰动瑞典全国的重大案件。

sentences.en: Stura Berevel, formerly known as Thomas Quick, was a Swedish man who confessed to committing more than 30 murders and cannibalising several of his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 斯图拉·贝雷维尔（曾用名托马斯·奎克）是一名瑞典男子，他承认犯下了30多起谋杀案，并吃掉了几名受害者。

sentences.en: He was ultimately convicted for eight of the murders and sentenced to psychiatric confinement.
sentences.zh: 他最终因其中八起谋杀案被定罪，并被判处精神病院监禁。

sentences.en: However, the confessions were made while Berevel was undergoing psychiatric treatment in a mental
sentences.zh: 然而，这些供词是在贝雷维尔于精神卫生机构接受治疗期间做出的，

sentences.en: health facility, and they only came about after a team of psychiatrists used recovered memory
sentences.zh: 而且是在一组精神科医生使用“恢复记忆疗法”，

sentences.en: therapy to extract vague information from a heavily medicated Berevel that could loosely tie him to the crimes.
sentences.zh: 从神志不清的贝雷维尔口中提取出模糊信息，并将其与犯罪事实勉强联系起来之后才出现的。

sentences.en: In the absence of any concrete evidence, the credibility of his confessions was hotly disputed,
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏任何确凿证据，他供词的可信度一直备受争议，

sentences.en: and when Berevel retracted all of his confessions in 2008, there was no ground for the convictions to stand on.
sentences.zh: 当贝雷维尔在2008年撤回所有供词时，这些定罪便失去了立足之地。

sentences.en: Professor Sherberry was part of the team that criticised the memory techniques used in Berevel's case, and all eight of his convictions were ultimately quashed.
sentences.zh: 谢伯里教授是批评贝雷维尔案中记忆提取技术的团队成员之一，他所有的八项定罪最终都被撤销了。

sentences.en: It was deduced that the psychiatric team had essentially used leading questions to coerce Berevel
sentences.zh: 据推断，精神科团队本质上是使用了诱导性提问，强迫贝雷维尔

sentences.en: into believing that he remembered certain details about the crimes, when in reality he had no involvement whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 相信自己记得犯罪的某些细节，而实际上他根本没有参与其中。

sentences.en: Berevel ultimately admitted he had lied about his involvement in the crimes because he enjoyed the
sentences.zh: 贝雷维尔最终承认，他对自己参与犯罪的供述撒了谎，因为他享受这种关注，

sentences.en: attention, and because the medication he was on enabled him to confidently create the false stories.
sentences.zh: 而且他当时服用的药物使他能够自信地编造出这些虚假故事。

sentences.en: In 2013, Sherberry began looking through the Kevin case, and noticed there were distinct similarities between it and the Thomas Quick case.
sentences.zh: 2013年，谢伯里开始研究凯文案，并注意到它与托马斯·奎克案之间存在明显的相似之处。

sentences.en: Not only did both cases rely strongly on repressed memories, but both investigations had been guided by the same memory specialist, Professor Sven Ocker Christiansen.
sentences.zh: 这两起案件不仅都严重依赖于“压抑记忆”，而且调查工作都由同一位记忆专家——斯文·奥克·克里斯蒂安森教授指导。
zh_words: 斯文·奥克·克里斯蒂安森

sentences.en: While Christiansen's work on repressed memories had seemed groundbreaking at the time, this methodology had since come under fire.
sentences.zh: 虽然克里斯蒂安森关于压抑记忆的研究在当时看起来具有开创性，但这种方法论后来受到了抨击。

sentences.en: Research had revealed that the so-called techniques used by therapists to recover repressed memories
sentences.zh: 研究表明，治疗师用来恢复压抑记忆的所谓技术，

sentences.en: also had the potential to create false memories of experiences that never happened.
sentences.zh: 也有可能制造出从未发生过的虚假记忆。

sentences.en: Professor Sherberry started reading about the techniques used to solve Kevin Yalmerson's murder, and was immediately suspicious.
sentences.zh: 谢伯里教授开始阅读关于侦破凯文·亚尔马森谋杀案所用技术的内容，并立即产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: There was simply no scientific evidence to support the interrogation techniques used against
sentences.zh: 根本没有任何科学证据支持针对

sentences.en: Robin and Christian.
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安的审讯技术。

sentences.en: Research had also taught him that having multiple, long interrogations with children can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 研究还告诉他，对儿童进行多次长时间的审讯可能是危险的。

sentences.en: The harder children are pressed, the more likely they are to tell police what they think they want to hear.
sentences.zh: 孩子受到的压力越大，他们就越有可能告诉警察他们认为警察想听的内容。

sentences.en: Sherberry couldn't help but wonder, what if the brothers hadn't had anything to do with
sentences.zh: 谢伯里不禁怀疑，如果兄弟俩根本与

sentences.en: Kevin's death after all?
sentences.zh: 凯文的死无关呢？

sentences.en: Professor Sherberry contacted Don Youssefson, a respected journalist whom he'd worked with on the Thomas Quick case and told him about his suspicions.
sentences.zh: 谢伯里教授联系了唐·尤瑟夫森，一位他在托马斯·奎克案中合作过的受人尊敬的记者，并告诉了他自己的怀疑。

sentences.en: Youssefson wasted no time in looking into the Kevin case himself.
sentences.zh: 尤瑟夫森没有浪费时间，亲自调查了凯文案。

sentences.en: He immediately shared Professor Sherberry's concerns that a severe miscarriage of justice might have taken place.
sentences.zh: 他立即认同了谢伯里教授的担忧，认为可能发生了严重的司法不公。

sentences.en: Christian and Robin's family had a strict no-media rule and they were near impossible to get in contact with.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安和罗宾的家人有严格的“拒绝媒体”规定，几乎无法与他们取得联系。

sentences.en: Don Youssefson persisted for five months and eventually they agreed to speak with him.
sentences.zh: 唐·尤瑟夫森坚持了五个月，最终他们同意与他交谈。

sentences.en: When the family learned of his intentions to make a documentary about the case, they were hesitant.
sentences.zh: 当家人得知他打算拍摄一部关于此案的纪录片时，他们犹豫了。

sentences.en: If Youssefson's suspicions were wrong and investigators had acted entirely above board, the family risked revealing their true identities after 17 years of secrecy.
sentences.zh: 如果尤瑟夫森的怀疑是错的，而调查人员的行为完全合规，那么这个家庭将面临在保守秘密17年后真实身份被曝光的风险。

sentences.en: All their hard work would be undone and Christian and Robin would be publicly outed as child killers.
sentences.zh: 他们所有的努力都将付诸东流，克里斯蒂安和罗宾将被公开贴上“杀童犯”的标签。

sentences.en: Youssefson made them a promise.
sentences.zh: 尤瑟夫森向他们许下了一个承诺。

sentences.en: If he and his team couldn't find any evidence to support their theory of a botched investigation, they'd forget about the documentary entirely.
sentences.zh: 如果他和他的团队找不到任何证据来支持他们关于调查拙劣的理论，他们就会彻底放弃这部纪录片。

sentences.en: The family agreed on the condition that they didn't want updates until Youssefson's team had completed their research.
sentences.zh: 家人同意了，条件是除非尤瑟夫森的团队完成研究，否则不要向他们提供进展更新。

sentences.en: Because the Kevin case was classified, the documentary crew had to use various sources to get their hands on the preliminary investigation.
sentences.zh: 由于凯文案属于机密，纪录片摄制组不得不利用各种渠道获取初步调查资料。

sentences.en: They eventually gained access to interrogation transcripts as well as some video footage of the interrogations.
sentences.zh: 他们最终获得了审讯记录以及一些审讯视频片段的访问权限。

sentences.en: The more they uncovered, the more shocked they became.
sentences.zh: 他们揭露得越多，就越感到震惊。

sentences.en: It was immediately clear that the interrogation team had acted unethically.
sentences.zh: 很明显，审讯团队的行为极其不道德。

sentences.en: The European Convention stipulates that children should only be interrogated once and never for a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 《欧洲公约》规定，儿童只能接受一次审讯，且绝不能长时间进行。

sentences.en: Robin and Christian were interrogated a total of 30 times, with some interrogations lasting over four and a half hours.
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安总共被审讯了30次，有些审讯持续了四个半小时以上。

sentences.en: Their parents were rarely present, even when the boys became visibly distressed.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母很少在场，即使孩子们表现出明显的痛苦时也是如此。

sentences.en: During the interrogations, the brothers had singled out a total of nine different perpetrators and mentioned at least seven different ways that Kevin had died.
sentences.zh: 在审讯过程中，兄弟俩总共指认了九名不同的肇事者，并提到了至少七种凯文死亡的方式。

sentences.en: They rarely repeated the same story twice.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎从未重复过同一个故事。

sentences.en: Up until the very last interrogations, at no point did either of the boys mention the pallet where Kevin was found or the correct method of Kevin's death.
sentences.zh: 直到最后几次审讯，两个孩子都没有提到发现凯文的托盘，也没有提到凯文死亡的正确方式。

sentences.en: It was only when the interrogation team fed them leading questions that they were able to provide the details the investigators seemed so desperate to hear.
sentences.zh: 只有当审讯团队对他们进行诱导性提问时，他们才能够提供调查人员似乎急于听到的细节。

sentences.en: In fact, the majority of the most damning statements made by the brothers had been the result of leading questions.
sentences.zh: 事实上，兄弟俩所做的大部分最具毁灭性的陈述，都是诱导性提问的结果。

sentences.en: One of the main reasons that Robin and Christian had been considered suspects
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安被视为嫌疑人的主要原因之一，

sentences.en: was that Robin had responded yes when Sundberry asked if his older brother was the one who killed Kevin.
sentences.zh: 是当桑德伯里问罗宾是否是他哥哥杀了凯文时，罗宾回答了“是”。

sentences.en: After being shocked by this response, Sundberry had proceeded to ask Robin 15 more times whether he saw Christian kill Kevin.
sentences.zh: 在对这个回答感到震惊后，桑德伯里继续问了罗宾15次，问他是否亲眼看到克里斯蒂安杀了凯文。

sentences.en: Of those 15 times, Robin replied yes eight times, but seven times he said no.
sentences.zh: 在这15次中，罗宾回答了8次“是”，但有7次他说“没有”。

sentences.en: It was clear from the interrogation reports and videos that investigators became increasingly frustrated as time went by.
sentences.zh: 从审讯报告和视频中可以清楚地看出，随着时间的推移，调查人员变得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: In the final stages of the investigation, the boys had been taken to the jetty with a life-sized doll in the hopes their so-called repressed memories would resurface.
sentences.zh: 在调查的最后阶段，孩子们被带到码头，带着一个真人大小的玩偶，希望他们所谓的“压抑记忆”能浮现出来。

sentences.en: When a visibly upset Christian had claimed that he didn't know how Kevin's injuries had occurred,
sentences.zh: 当情绪明显激动的克里斯蒂安声称他不知道凯文的伤是怎么造成的时，

sentences.en: Ingrid Hurrison had pushed him, saying,
sentences.zh: 英格丽德·哈里森推了他一把，说道：

sentences.en: Ingrid Hurrison was receiving directions from the rest of the team in her earpiece.
sentences.zh: 英格丽德·哈里森在耳机里接收着团队其他成员的指示。

sentences.en: She stopped beating around the bush and straight out told Robin where Kevin's body was found and that he had a bruise on his neck.
sentences.zh: 她不再拐弯抹角，直接告诉罗宾凯文的尸体是在哪里发现的，以及他的脖子上有淤青。

sentences.en: She even drew him pictures.
sentences.zh: 她甚至还画了图给他看。

sentences.en: From there, she proceeded to ask Robin more than a hundred times how the injuries occurred on Kevin's neck.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，她继续问了罗宾一百多次凯文脖子上的伤是怎么造成的。

sentences.en: Robin repeatedly said he didn't know.
sentences.zh: 罗宾反复说他不知道。

sentences.en: Eventually, with Hurrison continuously pressuring him to speak about Kevin's neck,
sentences.zh: 最终，在哈里森不断施压让他谈论凯文的脖子时，

sentences.en: Robin finally said that Christian pinched Kevin on the throat.
sentences.zh: 罗宾终于说克里斯蒂安掐了凯文的喉咙。

sentences.en: At no point did he mention helping carry Kevin's body to the palate.
sentences.zh: 他始终没有提到帮忙把凯文的尸体搬到托盘上。

sentences.en: Despite Hurrison literally telling him how and where Kevin had died,
sentences.zh: 尽管哈里森实际上已经告诉了他凯文是怎么死的以及死在哪里，

sentences.en: Robin seemed incapable of providing this information.
sentences.zh: 罗宾似乎还是无法提供这些信息。

sentences.en: The same technique was then used on Christian.
sentences.zh: 同样的技术随后被用在克里斯蒂安身上。

sentences.en: Over four and a half hours of questioning, he became increasingly distressed.
sentences.zh: 在四个半小时的审讯中，他变得越来越痛苦。

sentences.en: He cried and repeatedly asked for his mother.
sentences.zh: 他哭着反复要求见妈妈。

sentences.en: All up, he asked 61 times for the questioning to stop.
sentences.zh: 总共，他请求了61次停止审讯。

sentences.en: Instead, the interrogators told him he could only see his mother if he admitted what happened to Kevin.
sentences.zh: 相反，审讯人员告诉他，只有承认凯文身上发生了什么，他才能见到妈妈。

sentences.en: At this point, it was clear that he'd say anything if it meant he could leave, but he still couldn't provide the information they were so obviously hoping to hear.
sentences.zh: 此时，很明显只要能离开，他什么都愿意说，但他仍然无法提供他们显然急于听到的信息。

sentences.en: Instead, detectives showed Christian a photo map of the lake and blatantly pointed out the area where Kevin's body was found.
sentences.zh: 相反，侦探们向克里斯蒂安展示了一张湖泊的照片地图，并公然指出了发现凯文尸体的区域。

sentences.en: One detective asked,
sentences.zh: 一名侦探问：

sentences.en: Did you carry him there?
sentences.zh: “是你把他搬到那里的吗？”

sentences.en: Now realising what they wanted him to say, Christian said yes.
sentences.zh: 意识到他们想要他说什么，克里斯蒂安说了“是”。

sentences.en: However, he was still unable to explain how.
sentences.zh: 然而，他仍然无法解释是如何做到的。

sentences.en: For the investigative team, it didn't seem to matter.
sentences.zh: 对于调查组来说，这似乎并不重要。

sentences.en: That evening, lead investigator Rolf Sundberry interviewed the brothers and then wrote an official report declaring that they had made a full confession.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，首席调查员罗尔夫·桑德伯里采访了兄弟俩，然后写了一份官方报告，宣称他们已经做出了全面供述。

sentences.en: Interestingly, no other investigator was present during this significant interview and it was the only time during the entire investigation that Sundberry filed an official report.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在这次重要的采访中没有其他调查员在场，而且这是桑德伯里在整个调查过程中唯一一次提交正式报告。

sentences.en: Robin and Christian were both interviewed again the following morning, but this time neither of them repeated the confession they'd supposedly given the previous day.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，罗宾和克里斯蒂安再次接受了采访，但这一次他们都没有重复前一天所谓的供述。

sentences.en: The reality was, there wasn't a single piece of evidence to tie Robin and Christian to the crime.
sentences.zh: 事实是，没有任何证据将罗宾和克里斯蒂安与这起犯罪联系起来。

sentences.en: Their finger and handprints didn't match those found on the stick believed to be the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 他们的指纹和手印与在那根被认为是凶器的木棍上发现的痕迹不符。

sentences.en: In fact, there was no evidence that the stick was the murder weapon at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，根本没有证据表明那根木棍就是凶器。

sentences.en: Nobody had witnessed the brothers at the scene of the crime, nor had they provided any insider information until the interrogation team spoon-fed it to them.
sentences.zh: 没有人目击到兄弟俩在犯罪现场，在审讯团队喂给他们信息之前，他们也没有提供任何内部信息。

sentences.en: Forensic specialists also didn't think it was possible that the brothers could have moved Kevin from the jetty to the pallet,
sentences.zh: 法医专家也不认为兄弟俩有可能将凯文从码头搬到托盘上，

sentences.en: nor had they ever provided any explanation of how they managed to do so.
sentences.zh: 他们也从未解释过他们是如何做到这一点的。

sentences.en: At the time of the investigation, the authorities didn't think that Robin and Christian needed legal assistance because they weren't able to be prosecuted due to their age.
sentences.zh: 在调查时，当局认为罗宾和克里斯蒂安不需要法律援助，因为他们因年龄原因无法被起诉。

sentences.en: No one ever told the boys' parents about their right to a lawyer, and they had never thought to ask.
sentences.zh: 没有人告诉过孩子们的父母他们有权聘请律师，他们也从未想过要问。

sentences.en: Had a defence lawyer been brought in, they would never have allowed the brothers to be interrogated for so long or so many times.
sentences.zh: 如果当时有辩护律师介入，他们绝不会允许兄弟俩被审讯这么久或这么多次。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a crucial detail would have never slipped through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 此外，一个关键细节绝不会被遗漏。

sentences.en: At the time of Kevin's death, the Dallian family were close with another family called the Grawns, who had children similar in age to Robin and Christian.
sentences.zh: 在凯文去世时，达利安一家与另一个叫格劳恩的家庭关系密切，他们有和罗宾、克里斯蒂安年龄相仿的孩子。

sentences.en: The two families thought it would be nice to spend the last day of summer vacation together.
sentences.zh: 两家人认为一起度过暑假的最后一天会很不错。

sentences.en: On Sunday August 16 1998, the Grawns arrived at the Dallian's house mid-afternoon.
sentences.zh: 1998年8月16日星期日，格劳恩一家在下午时分到达了达利安家。

sentences.en: While the adults chatted inside, the three Grawn children played outside with Robin and Christian.
sentences.zh: 大人们在屋里聊天时，三个格劳恩家的孩子在外面和罗宾、克里斯蒂安一起玩。

sentences.en: As the eldest of the group, the Grawns' ten-year-old was put in charge and told to keep an eye on the younger kids.
sentences.zh: 作为这群孩子中最大的，格劳恩家十岁的孩子被委以重任，负责照看年幼的孩子们。

sentences.en: When police later questioned him, he was unwaveringly adamant that Robin or Christian never left his sight for any period of time.
sentences.zh: 当警察后来审问他时，他坚定不移地表示，罗宾或克里斯蒂安从未离开过他的视线。

sentences.en: Likewise, his mother had been keeping a close eye on the children from the window, and she confirmed that none of them ever strayed from view.
sentences.zh: 同样，他的母亲也一直从窗户密切注视着孩子们，她证实他们中没有任何人离开过视线。

sentences.en: After dinner, the two families left to go fishing at around 6pm.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，两家人在下午6点左右出发去钓鱼。

sentences.en: Christian rode in the car with the Grawn family, who stopped at a gas station just outside of Dottavik to put petrol in their car.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安和格劳恩一家坐同一辆车，他们在多塔维克郊外的一个加油站停下来加油。

sentences.en: This was corroborated by receipts as well as the gas station owner.
sentences.zh: 这一点得到了收据和加油站老板的证实。

sentences.en: During the fishing trip, all the children remained within view of the parents at all times.
sentences.zh: 在钓鱼期间，所有的孩子始终都在父母的视线范围内。

sentences.en: Police had been aware of this alibi since the early days of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 警方在调查初期就已经知道这个不在场证明了。

sentences.en: In fact, they'd interviewed the Grawns a total of 14 times, and they always told the same story.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们总共审问了格劳恩一家14次，他们每次都说了同样的故事。

sentences.en: Police never told Viner and Eva that their alibi had been verified, and the Grawn family stopped speaking to them in the wake of Kevin's death.
sentences.zh: 警察从未告诉维纳和伊娃他们的不在场证明已经得到核实，而格劳恩一家在凯文死后就停止与他们来往了。

sentences.en: This led to the boys' parents questioning their own recollection of that evening, and wondering whether the boys had indeed snuck off at some point without their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 这导致孩子们的父母开始质疑自己对那天晚上的记忆，并怀疑孩子们是否真的在他们不知情的情况下溜走了。

sentences.en: The suspicion against the brothers had been fuelled by Viner and Eva's admission that the boys may have had wet clothes on the night that Kevin had died,
sentences.zh: 对兄弟俩的怀疑源于维纳和伊娃承认孩子们在凯文去世的那天晚上可能穿着湿衣服，

sentences.en: and that they may have admitted to seeing Kevin be killed on the night that it happened.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能承认在事发当晚看到凯文被杀。

sentences.en: However, these admissions had been made while Eva and Viner were heavily medicated and receiving treatment at a psychiatric facility.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些供述是在伊娃和维纳服用大量药物并在精神病院接受治疗时做出的。

sentences.en: Police had persisted in asking probing questions, despite knowing full well that they were taking sedatives and suffering immense stress.
sentences.zh: 尽管明知他们正在服用镇静剂并承受着巨大的压力，警察仍坚持进行盘问。

sentences.en: Not only had investigators acted unethically and overlooked a crucial alibi, they'd been quick to rule out a potential person of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 调查人员不仅行为不道德，忽略了关键的不在场证明，而且还迅速排除了一个潜在的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: On May 7, 1999, just nine months after Kevin's death, a 50-year-old Dr Vic resident was walking through the playground near the lake when they came upon a horrifying incident.
sentences.zh: 1999年5月7日，即凯文死后仅九个月，一名50岁的维克医生居民在湖边的操场走过时，目睹了一起可怕的事件。

sentences.en: A three-year-old boy was being raped in the sandpit.
sentences.zh: 一个三岁的小男孩正在沙坑里被强奸。

sentences.en: The witness scared the perpetrator off, but managed to catch a good glimpse of him as he fled the scene.
sentences.zh: 目击者吓跑了肇事者，但在他逃离现场时看清了他的长相。

sentences.en: It was Felix, the same 13-year-old boy who had been spotted with Kevin Yalmarsson on the night that he was killed.
sentences.zh: 那是菲利克斯，正是那个在凯文·亚尔马森被杀当晚被发现和他在一起的13岁男孩。

sentences.en: Felix fled across the nearby border to Norway, but soon returned to Dr Vic and turned himself in.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯逃过了附近的边境进入挪威，但很快回到维克医生处自首。

sentences.en: He admitted to the crime, but given his age, he was sent to a treatment facility before returning to regular schooling.
sentences.zh: 他承认了罪行，但考虑到他的年龄，他被送往治疗机构，之后才回到学校上学。

sentences.en: Three years later, he was speaking to a classmate about the rape when he allegedly confessed,
sentences.zh: 三年后，他在和同学谈论那起强奸案时据称供认了（凯文案），

sentences.en: According to the book, The Story of the Kevin Case,
sentences.zh: 根据《凯文案的故事》一书，

sentences.en: Felix's family lived in the same apartment complex as Kevin's mother, Therese.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯的家人和凯文的母亲特蕾莎住在同一个公寓大楼里。

sentences.en: Just six days after Kevin was killed,
sentences.zh: 就在凯文被杀六天后，

sentences.en: Felix's mother suffered a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯的母亲心脏病发作。

sentences.en: Therese had rushed to help provide CPR and paramedics were able to revive her.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎冲过去帮忙进行心肺复苏，医护人员成功救活了她。

sentences.en: But when Therese heard that Felix had sexually assaulted a young child, she immediately became suspicious.
sentences.zh: 但当特蕾莎听说菲利克斯性侵了一名幼童时，她立刻产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: Was it possible that Felix's mother knew more about Kevin's death than she wanted to admit, and had that caused her heart attack?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能菲利克斯的母亲对凯文的死知道得比她愿意承认的更多，而这导致了她的心脏病发作？

sentences.en: There were several factors that made Felix appear suspect.
sentences.zh: 有几个因素让菲利克斯看起来很可疑。

sentences.en: Not only was he one of the last people seen with Kevin, but he'd also been the one who told the other children where they could find Kevin's shoes and socks behind the shed.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是最后见到凯文的人之一，而且还是他告诉其他孩子可以在棚屋后面找到凯文的鞋子和袜子的。

sentences.en: Felix had denied being with Kevin on the night of his death, despite multiple witnesses placing the two of them together.
sentences.zh: 尽管有多名目击者看到他们两人在一起，但菲利克斯否认在凯文遇害当晚和他在一起。

sentences.en: He told police that he'd rode around town for a while before visiting the library, then riding home.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警察，他在城里骑了一会儿车，然后去了图书馆，接着骑车回家。

sentences.en: However, had the police bothered to double-check this alibi, they would have discovered that the library was actually closed on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果警察费心去核实这个不在场证明，他们会发现图书馆周日其实是关门的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, no witnesses had seen Felix riding around town as he described.
sentences.zh: 此外，没有目击者看到菲利克斯像他描述的那样在城里骑车。

sentences.en: Before Felix arrived in Dotavik, he spent time in a refugee camp after fleeing war in his home country.
sentences.zh: 在到达多塔维克之前，菲利克斯在逃离家乡战争后在难民营待过一段时间。

sentences.en: His childhood had been marred by traumatic events and he also had an intellectual disability.
sentences.zh: 他的童年充满了创伤事件，而且他还有智力障碍。

sentences.en: After being revealed as a child rapist, many Dotavik residents began to wonder if he could have been the real perpetrator of Kevin's death.
sentences.zh: 在被揭露为强奸犯后，许多多塔维克居民开始怀疑他是否可能是凯文死亡的真正凶手。

sentences.en: The combined factors seemed way too coincidental and it was possible that the police could have written Felix off to avoid igniting xenophobia amongst Swedish citizens.
sentences.zh: 这些综合因素看起来太巧合了，警察很可能是为了避免在瑞典公民中引发仇外心理而排除了菲利克斯。

sentences.en: Kevin's family voiced their concerns to the authorities but were advised that Kevin's case was closed and that was that.
sentences.zh: 凯文的家人向当局表达了他们的担忧，但被告知凯文的案子已经结案，事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Robin and Christian's mother also found it curious that Felix wasn't looked into further.
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安的母亲也觉得奇怪，为什么没有对菲利克斯进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: She contacted both the police and the media to explore the possible connection but it seemed that nobody was interested in what she had to say.
sentences.zh: 她联系了警察和媒体去探索这种可能的联系，但似乎没有人对她的话感兴趣。

sentences.en: Felix has never provided an explanation as to how he knew that Kevin's shoes were behind the shed near the lake.
sentences.zh: 菲利克斯从未解释过他是如何知道凯文的鞋子在湖边棚屋后面的。

sentences.en: One year after Don Youssefson and his documentary team started digging around, they sat down with Robin, Christian and their parents
sentences.zh: 在唐·尤瑟夫森和他的纪录片团队开始挖掘一年后，他们与罗宾、克里斯蒂安及其父母坐在一起，

sentences.en: and presented them with the interrogation videos.
sentences.zh: 并向他们展示了审讯视频。

sentences.en: The family was absolutely floored.
sentences.zh: 这家人彻底惊呆了。

sentences.en: Although they'd always suspected that Robin and Christian were innocent, they'd been completely oblivious to how the interrogation team had behaved.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们一直怀疑罗宾和克里斯蒂安是无辜的，但他们完全不知道审讯团队的行为竟然如此恶劣。

sentences.en: Viner didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
sentences.zh: 维纳不知道该哭还是该笑。

sentences.en: After digesting what they'd seen, Christian remarked,
sentences.zh: 在消化了所见的一切后，克里斯蒂安评论道：

sentences.en: Every question mark is erased for me.
sentences.zh: 我心中的所有问号都消失了。

sentences.en: When the three-part documentary titled
sentences.zh: 当那部名为

sentences.en: Documents from Within – The Kevin Case aired on Sweden's SVT network in early May of 2017,
sentences.zh: 《内部文件——凯文案》的三集纪录片于2017年5月初在瑞典SVT电视台播出时，

sentences.en: Robin, Christian and their parents were extremely anxious.
sentences.zh: 罗宾、克里斯蒂安和他们的父母感到极度焦虑。

sentences.en: They feared the exposure might lead to a backlash.
sentences.zh: 他们担心曝光可能会招致反弹。

sentences.en: However, they received nothing but overwhelming support from the community who were completely outraged at the way the authorities had handled the investigation.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们得到的只有社区压倒性的支持，人们对当局处理调查的方式感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: In a subsequent press conference,
sentences.zh: 在随后的新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: Robin and Christian's full names were released to the public for the first time.
sentences.zh: 罗宾和克里斯蒂安的全名首次向公众公开。

sentences.en: The brothers spoke of the joy and relief they felt after the bungled investigation had been exposed and thanked the media for helping bring the truth to light.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩谈到了在拙劣的调查被曝光后他们感到的喜悦与解脱，并感谢媒体帮助真相大白。

sentences.en: Instead of living in fear of being recognised, they embraced the spotlight and welcomed people who approached to wish them well.
sentences.zh: 他们不再生活在被认出的恐惧中，而是拥抱聚光灯，欢迎那些前来祝福他们的人。

sentences.en: Robin told reporters,
sentences.zh: 罗宾告诉记者：

sentences.en: This is a new start.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新的开始。

sentences.en: We'll just keep trying to lead an ordinary life.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续努力过普通人的生活。

sentences.en: Work, house, car.
sentences.zh: 工作、房子、车子。

sentences.en: Not much planned beyond that.
sentences.zh: 除此之外没有太多计划。

sentences.en: Ordinary life goals.
sentences.zh: 普通的人生目标。

sentences.en: Christian commented,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安评论道：

sentences.en: They have taken years of my life that I will never ever get back.
sentences.zh: 他们夺走了我生命中永远无法找回的几年。

sentences.en: Now a new chapter begins.
sentences.zh: 现在新篇章开始了。

sentences.en: One can finally settle down.
sentences.zh: 人终于可以安定下来了。

sentences.en: I do not need to be afraid anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也不需要感到害怕了。

sentences.en: The brothers voiced their concerns for Kevin's family who would no doubt have old wounds reopened.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩表达了对凯文家人的关心，因为这无疑会揭开他们的旧伤疤。

sentences.en: Christian told reporters,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安告诉记者：

sentences.en: With the story gaining huge attention in the media, the case was formally reviewed by Chief Prosecutor Nicholas Vargrian.
sentences.zh: 随着这个故事在媒体上引起巨大关注，该案由首席检察官尼古拉斯·瓦格里安正式复核。

sentences.en: He dissected the interrogation records, reviewed Kevin's autopsy report, and interviewed over 80 people who had been involved in the initial investigation.
sentences.zh: 他剖析了审讯记录，审查了凯文的尸检报告，并采访了80多名参与最初调查的人员。

sentences.en: He concluded that there was absolutely no forensic evidence to indicate that Robin and Christian were involved in Kevin's death in any way,
sentences.zh: 他得出结论，绝对没有任何法医证据表明罗宾和克里斯蒂安以任何方式参与了凯文的死亡，

sentences.en: or that they were even present when he died.
sentences.zh: 或者说他们在凯文死亡时甚至在场。

sentences.en: Not only did they have a verified alibi from the very beginning, but the interrogation methods used against them were entirely unethical and unprofessional.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅从一开始就有经过核实的不在场证明，而且针对他们使用的审讯手段完全是不道德且不专业的。

sentences.en: Vargrian had no doubts about it.
sentences.zh: 瓦格里安对此毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Both Christian and Robin were entirely innocent.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安和罗宾完全是清白的。

sentences.en: The brothers were over the moon at finally being vindicated.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩终于洗清冤屈，欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: After the announcement, Christian told reporters,
sentences.zh: 宣布结果后，克里斯蒂安告诉记者：

sentences.en: They subsequently applied for financial compensation for the hardships they faced, but their application was rejected on the grounds that too much time had passed.
sentences.zh: 他们随后申请了经济赔偿以弥补所遭受的苦难，但他们的申请因时间过长而被驳回。

sentences.en: With the botched murder investigation exposed, it raised a serious question.
sentences.zh: 随着这起拙劣的谋杀调查被曝光，一个严重的问题随之产生。

sentences.en: If Robin and Christian didn't kill Kevin, then who did?
sentences.zh: 如果罗宾和克里斯蒂安没有杀害凯文，那到底是谁干的？

sentences.en: Chief Prosecutor Nicholas Vargrian believed there were several possibilities.
sentences.zh: 首席检察官尼古拉斯·瓦格里安认为有几种可能性。

sentences.en: While he wasn't prepared to completely rule out drowning, or that Kevin might have been killed by someone other than the brothers, it was more likely that he had died by accident.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没有完全排除溺水的可能，或者凯文可能被兄弟俩以外的人杀害，但更有可能的是他死于意外。

sentences.en: Judging by the injuries to his body, it was possible that Kevin had been playing by the lake, either alone or with another child,
sentences.zh: 从他身上的伤痕来看，凯文可能当时正在湖边玩耍，无论是独自一人还是与其他孩子在一起，

sentences.en: when a wooden pallet accidentally fell on top of him while trying to lift it.
sentences.zh: 当他试图抬起一块木托盘时，托盘意外地砸在了他身上。

sentences.en: The other child might have panicked, moved the pallet, and then fled the scene, vowing never to speak a word about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 另一个孩子可能惊慌失措，移开了托盘，然后逃离了现场，发誓绝口不提发生过的事情。

sentences.en: Alternatively, Kevin might have been playing with another child who could have sat on top of him, pushing his neck into the edge of the pallet, and accidentally strangling him.
sentences.zh: 或者，凯文可能在和另一个孩子玩耍时，对方可能坐在了他身上，将他的脖子压在托盘边缘，意外导致他窒息。

sentences.en: The prosecutor concluded that exactly what happened to Kevin would likely never be uncovered.
sentences.zh: 检察官总结说，凯文身上到底发生了什么可能永远无法揭开。

sentences.en: Kevin's father, Patrick, told the media that he would now have to learn to accept a new truth.
sentences.zh: 凯文的父亲帕特里克告诉媒体，他现在必须学会接受一个新的事实。

sentences.en: He remarked,
sentences.zh: 他评论道：

sentences.en: For almost 20 years I thought it was murder.
sentences.zh: 近20年来，我一直以为那是谋杀。

sentences.en: Now it looks like it was child's play ending in an accident.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，那是一场以意外告终的儿戏。

sentences.en: Believing something for such a long time, then everything changes, it's going to be a process to get through.
sentences.zh: 长期以来一直坚信某件事，然后一切都变了，这需要一个过程来克服。

sentences.en: Christian, Robin, and their parents wanted to do something to ensure that Kevin Yalmerson would be remembered not just as a name in a news headline,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安、罗宾和他们的父母想做点什么，以确保凯文·亚尔默森被记住的不仅仅是新闻标题里的一个名字，

sentences.en: but as the happy, friendly, and confident little boy they remembered him to be.
sentences.zh: 而是他们记忆中那个快乐、友好、自信的小男孩。

sentences.en: They also wanted to heal the wounds that the case had created for the city of Arvika.
sentences.zh: 他们还想治愈这起案件给阿尔维卡市造成的创伤。

sentences.en: With the blessing of Kevin's family, they created the Kevin Foundation, an organisation that would honour Kevin's memory while awarding two scholarships a year
sentences.zh: 在凯文家人的祝福下，他们成立了凯文基金会，这是一个旨在纪念凯文并每年颁发两项奖学金的组织，

sentences.en: to vulnerable teenagers in Arvika in a field of their choosing.
sentences.zh: 资助阿尔维卡那些弱势青少年在他们选择的领域发展。

sentences.en: The foundation aimed to reward those who fought against all odds to succeed academically.
sentences.zh: 该基金会旨在奖励那些克服重重困难取得学业成功的学生。

sentences.en: For years after Kevin's death,
sentences.zh: 在凯文去世后的几年里，

sentences.en: Kevin's mother, Therese,
sentences.zh: 凯文的母亲特蕾丝，

sentences.en: Therese was haunted by the accusations that she was a bad parent.
sentences.zh: 特蕾丝一直被关于她是个糟糕家长的指责所困扰。

sentences.en: Those years filled with mourning and resentment had blended into one and she looked back at them as a fog.
sentences.zh: 那些充满哀悼和怨恨的岁月交织在一起，她回首往事时，感觉就像一场迷雾。

sentences.en: After the truth was finally revealed, she was relieved to find solace with Eva and Viner, with whom she formed a close bond.
sentences.zh: 真相大白后，她很欣慰能从伊娃和维纳那里得到慰藉，并与他们建立了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: Like them,
sentences.zh: 和他们一样，

sentences.en: Therese had reluctantly accepted the police explanation that Robin and Christian had confessed to killing Kevin, despite questioning it herself for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 特蕾丝曾勉强接受了警方的解释，即罗宾和克里斯蒂安承认杀害了凯文，尽管她自己对此质疑了20年。

sentences.en: She was relieved that the truth had been exposed, even if it meant that the mystery of Kevin's death remained.
sentences.zh: 她很欣慰真相终于大白，即使这意味着凯文死亡的谜团依然存在。

sentences.en: When the initial investigation was underway, nobody made any objections to the way things were handled, and after Kevin's murder was solved,
sentences.zh: 当最初的调查进行时，没有人对处理方式提出任何异议，而在凯文的谋杀案告破后，

sentences.en: Rolf Sundberry was promoted to chief of Wormland Police.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫·桑德伯里被提升为沃姆兰警察局局长。

sentences.en: Two years before the documentary team re-examined the case,
sentences.zh: 在纪录片团队重新审查此案的两年前，

sentences.en: Sundberry suffered a head injury that affected his memory.
sentences.zh: 桑德伯里遭受了头部损伤，影响了他的记忆力。

sentences.en: Yet, he recalled that the brothers had been very clear about their confession and denied any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 然而，他记得兄弟俩对自己的供词非常明确，并否认有任何不当行为。

sentences.zh: 今天，罗宾和克里斯蒂安都已为人父，他们非常享受这个角色。
